newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia to issue five-year floating-rate DM bond.
newsitem.headline: Colombia to issue five-year floating-rate DM bond.

text.p: Colombia will issue a five-year floating-rate Deutschmark bond soon after a three-day roadshow through Germany, Britain and Switzerland set for next week, a government official said.

Clemente Del Valle, the Finance Ministry's chief of Public Credit, said the sovereign debt issue, which was being co-lead managed by Merrill Lynch and Deutsche Bank, could be launched as soon as by the end of next week.
Del Valle said he was unable to specify the exact amount of the bond issue, but he said $300 million could be used a tentative "reference point."
Finance Minister Jose Antonio Ocampo told Reuters earlier on Thursday that the government was planning an additional $300 million in sovereign debt issues this year.

The government was initially authorized by the central bank to issue $1.1 billion in sovereign debt in 1996 and it has already issued $1.08 billion. The central bank agreed to raise the ceiling to $1.4 billion after talks with finance ministry officials in late July, however.
